description:
Get the items of type microsoft.graph.user in the microsoft.graph.directoryObject collection

TIP: Lists recently deleted users (recoverable within 30 days). Use $select=displayName,userPrincipalName,deletedDateTime to see when each user was deleted. Useful for auditing account deletions and potential recovery.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-deleted-users
